intro: After uncovering the talkative remains of Alaric from a shallow grave outside Fenris Keep, adventurers are directed back inside the stronghold. Guided by the deceased human's memories, travelers seek out a forgotten alcove concealed behind a dusty shelf to grant him final repose and claim an old relic.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues. It also holds something you might find useful. Take me there!
The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.
Take my body, but leave my boots. They never fit me anyway...

clips.title: Progress
paras: This is the spot! Bring me closer...

clips.title: Completion
paras: There we are, it's open. Leave me here. I spent the best days of my life in this keep, and the thought of resting within its walls gives me comfort.
Be sure to close the alcove tight - I don't want those Rot Hides to find me.
Oh, and take this. You've earned it.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
